title: Rail fares to be frozen in England next year
summary: Regulated fares, which include season tickets and off-peak returns, will not see annual price rises for the first time in 30 years, the government announces.

title: Why Trump’s lavish Saudi courtship leaves Israel on the back foot

It was billed as a mere working visit, but it was more extravagant than any previous state visit. The president greeted the prince on the south lawn, the White House’s biggest stage.
